turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Beach day tomorrow. Is there anything about the weather I should check besides sunshine?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The wind and the tide times. A windy beach can feel cold and sandblasting even if it's sunny.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What wind speed is too much?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Above about fifteen or twenty miles an hour gets unpleasant. A windbreak helps a lot.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: At high tide some beaches almost disappear. Low tide is better for rock pools and space to play.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: For the record, Moshi agreed that the blue paint is nicer.

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Moshi isn't the one living here.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My grandma's old wooden chair has a wobbly leg and I really want to save it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll tell you all the choices first. Wait until I'm finished before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could squeeze some wood glue into the loose joint and clamp it overnight.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or take the whole chair apart, clean off the old glue, and reglue every joint.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or bring it to the furniture restorer in town, who's lovely but expensive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Phew, done. Tell me what you think.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If it's just one loose joint, the glue and clamp trick often works. Taking the chair apart is the proper fix, because new glue doesn't stick well to old glue. The restorer makes sense if it's valuable or has carvings.
